name: Church The
overview: Scripture reveals the church as a divinely established community, symbolized by the tender branch planted on a high mountain, destined to flourish and provide shelter (Ezekiel 17:22-23). The Lord sovereignly governs its growth, demonstrating His power to exalt and sustain it (Ezekiel 17:24). Despite severe persecution and opposition, as seen in the early scattering of believers and attacks led by Saul (Acts 8:1-3), the church endures as God's chosen instrument.
